fix: looksLikeClearCartMessage: «<verbo> todo(s) el/la/los/las/lo del/de X» is not a clear-cart command unless X is the cart, order, «nuevo» or «lo que…». parseScopedCartRemoval strips «todo(s) el/los … / todo lo del» and marks the removal as all matching lines in full; «una unidad de/del X» is a one-unit removal. tryHandleScopedCartRemoval removes every matching line for an «all» removal instead of asking which one. tryHandleSingleLineQuantityNudge reads «una unidad de X» as «una de X».
